## Web Scraping Checkpoint

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false

grViz("
digraph WebScraping {
  graph [rankdir = TB, fontsize = 12]
  
  # Global settings to prevent black boxes
  node [fontname = Helvetica, fontcolor = black]
  
  # Main topic
  main [label = 'Web Scraping\\n(HTML & CSS)', shape = box, style = filled, fillcolor = '#ADD8E6', fontsize = 14]
  
  # Main branches - Fixed fillcolors and explicit fontcolor
  html_branch [label = 'HTML Elements', shape = box, style = filled, fillcolor = '#90EE90']
  css_branch [label = 'CSS Selectors', shape = box, style = filled, fillcolor = '#90EE90']
  rvest_branch [label = 'rvest Functions', shape = box, style = filled, fillcolor = '#90EE90']
  
  main -> html_branch
  main -> css_branch
  main -> rvest_branch
  
  # HTML Elements
  html_parts [label = 'Element Parts', shape = box, style = filled, fillcolor = '#FFFFE0']
  html_example [label = 'Example:\\nText', shape = box, style = filled, fillcolor = '#F5DEB3']
  
  html_branch -> html_parts
  html_branch -> html_example
  
  # HTML parts
  start_tag [label = 'Start tag:\\n', shape = ellipse]
  end_tag [label = 'End tag:\\n', shape = ellipse]
  contents [label = 'Contents:\\nText', shape = ellipse]
  attributes [label = 'Attributes:\\nid=first', shape = ellipse]
  
  html_parts -> start_tag
  html_parts -> end_tag
  html_parts -> contents
  html_parts -> attributes
  
  # CSS Selectors
  css_element [label = 'Element selector', shape = box, style = filled, fillcolor = '#FFFFE0']
  css_class [label = 'Class selector', shape = box, style = filled, fillcolor = '#FFFFE0']
  css_id [label = 'ID selector', shape = box, style = filled, fillcolor = '#FFFFE0']
  
  css_branch -> css_element
  css_branch -> css_class
  css_branch -> css_id
  
  # CSS details
  elem_syntax [label = 'p\\nselects all tags', shape = ellipse]
  elem_class [label = 'p.important\\nselects ', shape = ellipse]
  
  css_element -> elem_syntax
  css_element -> elem_class
  
  class_syntax [label = '.title\\nselects class=title', shape = ellipse]
  css_class -> class_syntax
  
  id_syntax [label = '#title\\nselects id=title', shape = ellipse]
  css_id -> id_syntax
  
  # rvest Functions
  read_fn [label = 'read_html():\\nread HTML document', shape = ellipse]
  elements_fn [label = 'html_elements():\\nselect elements', shape = ellipse]
  text_fn [label = 'html_text2():\\nextract contents', shape = ellipse]
  attr_fn [label = 'html_attr():\\nextract attributes', shape = ellipse]
  
  rvest_branch -> read_fn
  rvest_branch -> elements_fn
  rvest_branch -> text_fn
  rvest_branch -> attr_fn
}
")
```
